notes.title: Five new character portraits!
notes.content:
Awesome news if you like art- the artist that designed and rendered the portraits used in the game has released FIVE more! Three males and two very powerful and confident looking females. Since the story was set in place with the previous number of portraits, the community can help in coming up with roles and personalities for these new characters!
